editorial:
Imagine waking up in the body of a creepy serial killer while he is lounging around in your teenage girl body. That is exactly what happens here after a magic dagger causes a wild switch. You get to follow Millie, a shy high schooler, and the Butcher, a cold-blooded murderer, as they scramble to get their own bodies back. It is a total blast that mixes scary slasher vibes with laugh-out-loud comedy. The movie does not take itself too seriously, making it the perfect pick for a Friday night when you just want something fun and weird to watch.

What really makes this work is the acting. Seeing a grown man act like a terrified teen girl is hilarious, and the pacing keeps you on your toes. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the action scenes are punchy and satisfying. If you are into horror movies that make you giggle, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you love owning movies, add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection so you can rewatch the best jokes.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Millie and the Butcher fight for control of the magic dagger. Millie manages to outsmart him and stabs him while he is in her body. Since the killer is now trapped in the girl's body, he dies. Millie then uses the dagger one last time to switch back into her own body just before the clock runs out. She survives, the killer is gone, and she finally finds some confidence.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror comedies and body-swap stories
